title: Earthy Corn Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional tacos, featuring earthy mushrooms, baked corn, and a hint of greek yogurt.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Earthy variety such as cremini or shiitake

instructions: 2. In a bowl, toss corn kernels with 1 tablespoon olive oil, cumin, and chili powder. Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
3. In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
4. Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
5. Assemble tacos by spooning mushroom mixture onto a shell, followed by toasted corn kernels, and a dollop of greek yogurt.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
